note: Pinned Android toolchain for App Studio APK builds (scripts/space-android-toolchain-setup.mjs installs it under <dir>, default /opt/spaceapp/var/toolchains/android; scripts/space-app-studio-build.mjs reads it there). The JDK, cmdline-tools and Gradle archives are checked by SHA-256 and size; sdkmanager installs the SDK packages at their exact revisions and checks each archive against Google's repository checksum. The versions are what Expo SDK 58 (React Native 0.88, expo-modules-autolinking 58.0.14 ExpoRootProjectPlugin defaults, expo-template-bare-minimum 58.0.26) builds with; another Expo SDK needs this file updated.
